text:
maya: Quick design review request — new Private Setup wizard network step. Focus: probe affordances, retry UX, and copy for actionable errors. Posting current screenshot + copy in thread.

oliver: Looks good overall. Main nit: the "diagnostics" CTA feels buried. Suggest moving a primary `Run diagnostics` button next to the probe status (right side) so users can retry without scrolling. Also consider changing the status pill copy from 'Failed' to 'Connectivity issue — click to run diagnostics' for clarity. :thinking_face:

sanjay: Agree on the CTA placement. Implementation constraint: diagnostics kicks off an ephemeral probe from the control plane and can take ~6–12s. If we make it primary, we'll need an inline loading state and to debounce repeated clicks. Also, we return three result buckets: `egress_ok`, `egress_blocked`, `ssh_unreachable` — would like UI copy that maps to these.

maya: Good point on load state. Proposal for states and microcopy:
- egress_ok -> "Network reachable: required egress ports open" (green)
- egress_blocked -> "Egress blocked: some outbound ports are filtered — run diagnostics or see troubleshooting" (yellow)
- ssh_unreachable -> "Bastion unreachable: can't reach on-prem SSH probe — check inbound rules or local firewall" (red)

oliver: Copy tweak suggestions (short, action-first):
- egress_blocked -> "Outbound blocked — run diagnostics"
- ssh_unreachable -> "Bastion unreachable — check inbound SSH and bastion host"
Keep the pill short; surface the longer explanation in a hover tooltip or an expandable details row. For screen readers, announce the detailed explanation via an ARIA live region when the probe completes.

anya: Accessibility nits: keyboard focus order must land on the diagnostics CTA after the status pill, and the expand/collapse details should be reachable via Enter/Space. Add aria-labels: `aria-live="polite"` for success notices, `aria-live="assertive"` for errors. Also add a visually-hidden prefix on the pill like "Probe result:" so NVDA/VoiceOver reads it as a result update.

maya: Nice — can we standardize the button labels? I propose: primary button `Run diagnostics`, secondary `View connectivity details`. In the collapsed state show a one-line summary row: status pill + latency (if measured) + `Run diagnostics` button.

sanjay: For the details panel we can include a minimal table of probe checks (egress ports, DNS resolution, SSH handshake). Example payload we return from the probe:```json
{
  "status":"egress_blocked",
  "checks":[
    {"name":"DNS","ok":true},
    {"name":"TCP 443 outbound","ok":false,"hint":"Outbound HTTPS blocked to api.redwood.ai:443"},
    {"name":"SSH 22 inbound","ok":false,"hint":"No response from bastion.example.local:22"}
  ]
}
```
We should map `hint` strings to friendly copy in the UI and link each hint to the KB article (short anchor links).

oliver: Small visual suggestion — use a collapsible card with three affordances: short summary, action row (Run diagnostics), and the expanded details. Animate height so keyboard users can notice the change. Also give the pill a more descriptive aria-label like `Probe result: outbound blocked` when relevant.

maya: One more: retry/backoff UX. If diagnostics returns the same failure repeatedly, show a contextual nudge: "Still blocked after retry? Try a local curl from your bastion: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health`". We shouldn't dump full logs in the UI, but offer a copyable command and a downloadable raw probe report (JSON).

anya: For screen-reader users, when they click "View connectivity details" move focus to the panel heading and ensure it's announced. Also add an inline link text "How to run the local probe" that opens KB in a new tab and has `rel=noopener noreferrer`.

deploy-bot: [automated probe result] 2178001300 — status: egress_blocked, details available (click to expand).

maya: Thanks — will mock up updated layout with button on the right and aria-live regions. I'll post new screenshots shortly. Any objections to the pill copy `Outbound blocked — run diagnostics`?

oliver: 👍 from design. Maybe test with shorter wording on narrow screens: `Outbound blocked — diagnostics`.

sanjay: No objections. One engineering ask: when status==egress_blocked, include `port_hint` in the summary (e.g., "Blocked: 443") so we can show a tiny chevron tooltip to indicate the likely port.

anya: JIC: add `aria-describedby` on the pill pointing to the expanded detail id so assistive tech has a persistent description.

maya: Cool — I'll iterate and share a Figma frame and a quick prototype keyboard walkthrough. Posting initial mock at https://redwood-internal.design/s/priv-wizard-probe-v2 :)

oliver: Quick microcopy alternatives for the download action: `Download report` vs `Export diagnostics` — prefer `Download report` (clearer).

maya: Noted. I'll include both variants in the mock so we can A/B.

sanjay: FYI I'll add backend metrics for probe latency and failure count so Console can show rates over time in the setup summary if helpful.

maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. End-to-end checklist for follow-ups:
- oliver: updated mock + microcopy (due EOD)
- sanjay: add port_hint to probe payload + rate metric (PR)
- anya: accessibility checklist + aria attributes in component library
- maya: post prototype + commit copy changes

oliver: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

anya: Happy to pair on ARIA details if needed.

maya: Closing the review thread — will reopen if new blockers show up.
